title: Slow the Heart
description: A double breath in, a long breath out. Brings the heart rate down quickly.

steps.text: Stand, or sit down, whichever feels right. Your heart is still working hard. That's fine.
We'll use a double breath. In through the nose, then a little more on top. Then a long, slow breath out through the mouth.
Keep going on your own. Let every breath out be long and easy.
Now let the breath be natural. Notice the heartbeat slowing down, all on its own.
Good. Carry this calm with you.
